entries.en: to respect and venerate; to worship
to worship; to bow in homage

entries.zh: 拜东（官员朝东行拜礼，是其崇敬之礼）
entries.en: the mandarin worships toward the east, which is his act of veneration
to kneel and worship; to venerate on one's knees

entries.zh: 妆扮；修饰打扮（＝componer、afeitar，梳妆整饰）
entries.en: to adorn, dress up; to make oneself up, spruce up
to adorn oneself so as to look well; to dress up
entries.notes: 词头为缩写 p.a（para），展开依赖推断；汉字「飾」与音 sêy 互证尚稳。

entries.en: to adorn the face; to make up, beautify the face

entries.zh: 笄；女子加笄梳妆（女子打扮）
entries.en: a woman adorns herself; hairpin ritual of a woman's adornment
entries.notes: 汉字「笄」本义为簪，此处按词头取女子梳妆义；释义略依赖推断。

entries.en: to adorn oneself wantonly; to deck out lasciviously

entries.zh: 上头；修饰头部（梳发整饰头顶）
entries.en: to adorn the head; to dress the hair

entries.zh: 冠巾；戴冠束巾（头部装束）
entries.en: to adorn the head with cap and kerchief; cap and head-cloth

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕印土砖；土坯砖（西语 adobes 之残形？）
entries.en: 〔damaged in original; gloss uncertain〕sun-dried bricks, adobes
entries.notes: 词头「Adoues」疑为 adobes（土坯/晒砖）之误写或缺损；汉字栏多字待定（塼/增/墼），仅凭三音节音写推断。

entries.zh: 渡头；码头，关栈起卸处（aduana＝税关码头）
entries.en: wharf, landing place; customs port where goods are shipped and landed
to notice, become aware; to perceive, judge, conjecture
entries.notes: 西语词头取「觉察/推断」义，与汉字「觉」互证清晰，但 juzgar 义的取舍依赖 17 世纪语义推断。

entries.zh: 知觉；审慎地觉察，明白察觉
entries.en: to perceive prudently; to be aware, take heed
entries.notes: 词头为缩写形式，展开「prudentemente」依赖推断；「知觉」二字互证明确。
